name: Beef Deshebrada Sopes
subtitle: Guajillo-braised shredded chuck on masa sopes, with refried pintos and calabacitas
equipment: Instant Pot, blender, large skillet, saucepan, rice cooker or pot

macros.basis: per portion, 1 of 7, averaged with the sopes
macros.note: Rough estimate from standard nutrition values for the listed amounts, not a lab number. Averaged across all 7: dinner plates carry the sopes, lunch containers carry the rice.

before: Toast the chiles only until fragrant. Burnt chiles turn the whole sauce bitter.
notes: Carne deshebrada is stewed in a guajillo-ancho chile sauce, then shredded and cooked down until the sauce clings. The chuck isn't seared first; that's typical for this dish. Sopes are thick masa cakes with a pinched rim, griddled and then crisped. They're traditionally fried in lard; here they get a light brush of oil on a dry skillet instead, which is less rich and a little less crisp. Everything except the shredding happens while the pot is under pressure.

items: 1 cup plain nonfat Greek yogurt + 2 Tbsp lime juice + pinch salt

steps.title: Toast the chiles
steps.body: Stem and seed **6 guajillo + 2 ancho chiles** and tear them flat. In a dry skillet over medium, toast 20–30 seconds per side, just until fragrant and pliable.

steps.title: Soften the sauce base
steps.body: Into the Instant Pot: the chiles, **3 Roma tomatoes** halved, **½ white onion** in chunks, **5 cloves garlic** and **1 cup broth**. Sauté High, simmer **8 min** until the chiles are soft.

steps.title: Cut the beef
steps.body: While it simmers: cut **3 lb chuck** into 2-inch chunks, trimming off any thick pieces of fat. Toss with **2 tsp kosher salt**.

steps.title: Blend
steps.body: Cancel Sauté. Carefully pour the pot into the blender with **1 Tbsp cider vinegar + ½ tsp cumin + 1 tsp Mexican oregano + 2 cloves**. Blend until smooth, with the lid vent cracked and a towel over it.

steps.title: Pressure cook
steps.body: Beef into the pot, sauce poured over the top, **2 bay leaves** on top. Don't stir. Lid on, valve sealed. High pressure **50 min**, then natural release **15 min**. Everything below happens during this time.

steps.title: Masa dough
steps.body: Mix **2½ cups masa harina + 1 tsp salt**, then work in **2¼ cups warm water** by hand until it feels like soft play dough and doesn't crack at the edges when pressed. Add water a spoonful at a time if it cracks. Cover and rest **10 min**.

steps.title: Start the rice
steps.body: Rinse **1½ cups rice** and cook with **2 cups water** in the rice cooker, or in a covered pot: boil, then lowest heat **15 min**, then rest **10 min** off heat. It's for the lunches; it can sit covered until you pack them.

steps.title: Toppings
steps.body: Shred **1 romaine heart**. Finely dice **½ white onion**. Slice **1 bunch radishes**. Crumble **10 oz queso fresco**. Whisk **1 cup Greek yogurt + 2 Tbsp lime juice + a pinch of salt**. Cut the rest of the **limes** into wedges. Refrigerate.

steps.title: Form the sopes
steps.body: Divide the dough into **12 balls**. Press each between two pieces of plastic (a cut zip-top bag works) with a pie plate or flat pan into a 3½-inch round about ¼-inch thick. Keep them covered.

steps.title: Refried pintos
steps.body: Saucepan over medium: **1 Tbsp neutral oil**, then **½ onion** diced, **4 min**. Add **2 cloves garlic** minced for 30 seconds, then **3 cans pintos** (drained and rinsed), **¾ cup water** and **½ tsp salt**. Simmer **8 min**, mashing to a coarse purée. Cover, off heat.

steps.title: Calabacitas
steps.body: Dice **3 zucchini** and **2 Romas** into ½-inch pieces. In the skillet over medium-high: **1 Tbsp olive oil**, **½ onion** diced, **3 min**; then **2 cloves garlic** minced, the zucchini, **2 cups frozen corn**, **½ tsp oregano** and **½ tsp salt**. Cook **6–8 min** until the zucchini browns in spots. Stir in the tomatoes for the last minute. Into a bowl; wipe the skillet.

steps.title: Griddle the sopes
steps.body: Oven to 200°F to hold them. Dry skillet over medium-high. Cook the rounds **2 min** per side until spotted. While each is still hot, pinch up a ½-inch rim around the edge with your fingertips (use a towel; it's hot). Into the oven as you go.

steps.title: Shred and reduce
steps.body: Once the pin drops, move the beef to a board and shred with two forks. Discard the bay leaves. Sauté High and boil the sauce hard **8–10 min**, stirring often, until it's thick and glossy. Beef back in, stir to coat, and taste for salt.

steps.title: Crisp and build
steps.body: Brush the sope bottoms with **1 Tbsp neutral oil** total and crisp them flat-side down in the skillet **1–2 min**. Top each with beans, then beef, then lettuce, onion, radish, queso fresco and crema. Calabacitas and lime wedges on the side.

after: Pack 3 lunches: beef, refried pintos, calabacitas and rice.
Leftover sope shells keep 2 days in the fridge; re-crisp in a dry skillet.
